component.name: Video Downloader
component.summary: Download videos and audio with yt-dlp

description.p: A desktop front end for yt-dlp with a download queue, parallel or sequential transfers, per-item progress and pause/resume.
Finished files appear in a video grid and a music list, and every file stays in the folder you chose. Audio-only downloads need FFmpeg.
